## Summary

What does this pull request change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Dataset: new certification
- [ ] Dataset: correction (price, URL, name, level, domain, description)
- [ ] Code: bug fix
- [ ] Code: new feature
- [ ] Docs

## Checklist

- [ ] If I touched `data/certs.csv`, I ran `npm run validate` and the script exited successfully.
- [ ] If I touched the schema or vocabularies, I updated `data/schema.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] For dataset changes, I linked the vendor's official page as the source for the values.
- [ ] For code changes, I tested in at least one browser at desktop and mobile widths.
